attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It is day 130 of Aprimay","severity":"minor","reason":"garbles the date; briefing gives day 130 (Aprimay 5502), but a day 130 within a month is odd and implies a different calendar reading"},{"span":"the rim's loudest news is a carving","severity":"minor","reason":"unsupported claim that it is the loudest news on the rim; briefing says only that traders talk about it"},{"span":"I suspect most of the people discussing it have not either","severity":"minor","reason":"framed as a guess, so allowed; no fact invented"},{"span":"Some years, one learns to call that luck.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies past years of similar quiet news; an unsupported comparison with earlier states"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The dry voice is consistent, and it leads correctly with the new item and keeps to the briefing's facts.
